native_scope: 49 original FAST campaigns from B-ALL, frozen original journal. Matched cohort gates report both excluded winners and losers. Delayed or exit variants do not get a retrospective native performance claim.
replay_scope: Fixed universe of original submitted FAST plans, warmed from full OHLC. Next observed open, one portfolio, frozen signal reference/stop, 3 equal 1/2/3R parts and 0.05R lock after TP1, max holding 48 bars, invalid entry deviation greater than 0.20 signal ATR flattened next open if residual, conservative stop-first. Position competition outside that selected universe is unrecoverable.

fast_trials.F1: Directional candle body / full signal range >= 0.55, zero range rejects
fast_trials.F2: Next contiguous close at least 0.10 original signal ATR beyond frozen preceding four-bar breakout boundary, no prior stop breach; new decision at that close
fast_trials.F3: Current close beyond previously confirmed 3/3 swing in signal direction and H1 closed EMA alignment agrees
fast_trials.F4: First of next 1–4 contiguous bars whose adverse extreme lies within 0.15 original signal ATR of frozen boundary and closes beyond boundary; cancel on close through boundary or stop breach
fast_trials.F6: Breakout extension <= 0.25 signal ATR at confirmation; proxy because original FAST setup birth equals confirmation
fast_trials.F7: Known nearest forward obstacle (previous confirmed swing, preceding UTC day/week extreme or prior 20-bar extreme) at least 1 planned R from signal reference; unknown rejects
fast_trials.F8: Directional base timeframe regime agrees with signal side
fast_trials.F9: London or New York window at decision UTC, DST-aware using existing native-report helper
fast_trials.F10: Directional RSI >= 55 long or <= 45 short and directional two-bar close change >= 0.25 ATR
fast_trials.F11: F0 admission; first post-entry close at or through frozen preceding four-bar boundary queues residual exit at next open
fast_trials.F12: F1 + F7 only, fixed before the new calculations; no optimized combination

entry_variant_stop_policy: For F2/F4 keep original structural SL, recompute entry reference and R projections at delayed confirmation and reject if signed risk below one tick.

model.universe: All complete campaigns from B-ALL; only confirmed bar feature values or submitted metadata
model.split: chronological 60/20/20 and expanding walk-forward 30 initial/12 per block; label end < boundary minus 900000ms; train-only scaling
model.policy: fixed threshold 0.5 descriptive accepted/rejected net R and USD; model promotion disabled
model.advanced_models: Defer pending >=300 nonoverlapping labeled campaigns and independent validation; evaluation set already observed

metrics: bootstrap mean net R and exploratory Holm adjustment
inference: No new independent data, no promote; archive all positive, negative, zero and censored outcomes.
